messages:
alex: Kicking off a soft-siphon plan for router v2 -> v3 tonight 03:00 UTC. Quiet window 03:00-03:45. I scheduled a slow weight ramp from deploy-bot; want ops + SRE eyes.
maria: Confirming. What's the step plan and rollback guardrails? @sre-jen can you validate p95 thresholds?
deploy-bot: Scheduled traffic shift: weights [5%, 20%, 50%, 100%] at +5m, +12m, +25m, +35m. Canary probes: /health, /v2/ping. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/soft-siphon-2026
sre-jen: Looking. Suggest explicit rollback triggers: p95 > 200ms sustained 5m OR error-rate spike > 0.5% above baseline OR tail latency regression in model-serving layer. Also block promoting to 100% if session-affinity mismatch > 1%.
ops-nik: Edge pool warmup: ensure pool-b has at least 2 warm VMs for 10m before first shift. Draining config: set graceful_timeout=60s on router, conn_drain=120s on LB. Will run warmup at 02:50 UTC.
product-liz: Also add a short note in release notes: "router: soft siphon to v3, incremental traffic ramp. See runbook for rollback criteria." I'll post to docs once we greenlight.
maria: For rollback automation, can we wire deploy-bot to auto-abort at step if /metrics shows the triggers? I don't want manual only.
alex: Yes — deploy-bot is configured to auto-pause and send alert if any of the SRE triggers fire. Manual confirmation required for full 100% promotion unless override flag `--force-complete` used.
sre-jen: One more: session affinity/cookies — v3 expects stateless routing. Please set cookie_pin: disabled for this trial cohort, else sticky sessions cause skew.
ops-nik: Done. I pushed config to router-canary with `cookie_pin: false` and posted a quick check:
```bash
# verify cookie pin off
curl -s -I https://router-internal/probe | grep Set-Cookie || echo "no-cookie"
```
deploy-bot: Probe results at 02:58 UTC: /health OK, avg latency 85ms, error-rate 0.03%. Proceeding with 5% step at 03:00 UTC.
alex: Rolling to 5% now. Monitor p95 and traces. Slack alert channel is #deploy-alerts.
maria: Watching logs, no red flags at 5%. p95 92ms, errors flat.
ops-nik: Increasing to 20% in 7m per plan. Edge poolB connections stable, drain counts zero.
sre-jen: At 20% step — p95 110ms, tail looks clean. No model mismatch warnings. Good to continue.
ops-nik: Promoted 50% at +25m. Watching for session replays and 5xx.
product-liz: I updated release notes and pinned the runbook link in #releases.
deploy-bot: Final promotion scheduled at +35m. Auto-rollback hook armed.
alex: If any of the SRE triggers hit, rollback to v2 and set traffic to 0% for v3, then engage postmortem. Otherwise we aim to flip to 100% at +40m and close the window.
sre-jen: Acknowledged. I'll leave a short watch for 30m post-100% for any regressions.
maria: Thanks everyone. If nothing else, I'll close the run once 00:45 UTC after observation window.
alex: All good — closing here unless someone raises an objection.
